scope: Genuine dependent-store and upload custody at original ready, operational, aggregate-room and generation participant handoff boundaries. Ordinary save failures remain retryable. Not whole-room generation activation, platform durability or V1 approval.

source.postQualificationChanges: Only five recovery/release guides and this scoped qualification record. Package README and all production/test inputs were frozen before qualification.

repairedPaths: Original ready and operational participant handoffs refuse retirement of every selected suggestion, revision, version and upload store after actual asynchronous release.
The aggregate room commit checks every child's dependent owners after the final host callback and before consuming any child.
Generation ready and operational handoffs refuse an upgraded or explicitly closed upload owner; genuine ready-to-operation transfer also checks final source/upload liveness.
implementation.admission: Genuine constructor registrations bind packet owners to their original core, source and private lease/lifecycle checks. Independent storage-version retirement is irreversible and distinct from an ordinary retryable save failure. No edit, native hold, save or notification is used as an admission probe.
implementation.publicApiAddition: RichAssetStore.checkOpen(): void is an additive pure synchronous liveness check. It performs no I/O, upload, mutation or notification and is not a flush, idle barrier, exact-cut or provider-closure proof.
implementation.retention: Late refusals consume no partial owner group and preserve committed native/packet/upload records, exact original files and readable packet exports. Post-release owners are cleanup-only. Upgraded destinations are not downgraded or overwritten; separately named fresh recovery follows explicit cleanup.
implementation.authorityBoundary: Host work still must be settled and fenced. Local ownership checks do not revoke preexisting host references, authenticate current server/account permission, reconcile provider references or fence other devices.

tests.storageLocksAndRaster: Actual canonical Wasm and native hosts with explicit synthetic IndexedDB, locks and raster decoding. Controlled lifecycle faults, not physical-browser or process/power-loss durability.

explicitOverrides.reason: Reuse only the hash-verified paired Wasm producers after checking 2,747 unchanged native inputs. New handoff tests, all prior consumer assertions and ordinary native inventory builds still run; the permanent plans retain their normal producer-build requirements.

verification.producerReuseScope: Only the paired Wasm producers are reused. Inventory fixture builds and native assertions run normally; no fresh full Rust-suite qualification is claimed.
